item.text: I’ll inspect the frontend suggestion reader and its existing tests, then make a scoped change and run the relevant frontend checks. I’ll avoid authentication files and Git history as requested.

The lexer already keeps quoted tokens atomic, and the Boolean parser treats their decoded values as opaque. I’m extending its token pattern and decoder so raw literals retain their contents while ordinary literals keep their current escape handling.
The regression cases now cover raw content, both quote styles and prefixes, syntax-like text inside literals, and an unclosed raw string. I’ll run the focused frontend test and lint checks now.

item.text:
Added single line raw string support to the frontend suggestion reader. Raw literals keep backslashes and syntax-like text as literal content; ordinary string escape decoding is unchanged. Added regression cases for raw strings in Boolean expressions, negation, and malformed unclosed input.

Checks run: `pnpm test -- memo-suggestions.test.ts`, `pnpm lint`, and `git diff --check`. All passed.
